audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls this HARD 8/10 and gives Syndra all seven full-layer rows, while the content layer wins all seven for Diana, the packet levelChart is all Diana, and the Emerald+ win rate is 53.03% over 3566 games.
audit.why: Dark Sphere is 800 range against Diana's 900 Q, so the crescent is not out-ranged except by Force of Will at 925. Scatter the Weak is a flat 15s and only stuns when it pushes a Dark Sphere through you, which is a two-cast setup Diana's Q-mark into a cooldown-free Lunar Rush beats.
audit.corrected: Even matchup: move the full-layer sides onto the content/packet verdict and drop the difficulty to 5.5/10, keeping Syndra's carry threat high at 8/10.
sources: enemyKit Q range 800, E cd flat 15

audit.why: Level 3 mark-dash, level 6 Moonfall against a 120s rank-1 Unleashed Power, first item, late reset chains. The ultimate cooldown gap (Moonfall 100s vs Unleashed Power 120s at rank 1) is real and already reflected in the content spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: tldr claims she out-ranges the crescent and that her E stops the dash mid-flight; breakdown.cooldowns has no digit in it (lint); and nothing on the page mentions that Transcendent and Force of Will deal true damage or that Unleashed Power executes.
audit.why: Riot's text for Scatter the Weak is a knockback that stuns enemies hit by Dark Spheres — it says nothing about interrupting dashes, so that claim is not supportable from the kit. The Splinters of Wrath passive explicitly gives Force of Will bonus true damage and makes Unleashed Power execute low-health targets, which is exactly why MR is the wrong purchase here.
audit.corrected: Rewrite tldr around Force of Will's 925 range and the sphere-dependency of the stun; put the 15s / 7s / 15s / 120s numbers into breakdown.cooldowns; state the true-damage and execute problem in breakdown.mid.

notes: Chart: the full layer gave Syndra all seven rows while content win[] and packet.levelChart both give Diana all seven, and the win rate is 53.03% over 3566 games. I moved the full layer onto the content values, so there is NO paired win[N] edit — win[N] is already correct on every row and an edit whose before equals its after cannot be written. The existing phases whys already described Diana winning, so the rows stop arguing with themselves once the sides move. I did not drop carryRating below 8/10: Syndra's true damage and execute keep her threat genuinely high even in an even lane. packet.suspectNames entries for wants.foe[1] and wants.foe[2] are FALSE POSITIVES — 'Scatter the Weak' and 'Unleashed Power' are the real Riot names; no edit made. report[8] Itemization should eventually mention that MR is a poor buy into her true damage, but report[] is out of sweep scope and the lint did not flag it, so I put that fact in breakdown.mid instead.
